name: skylark_turn_on_gate_change_alerts
intent: Turn on gate change alerts for a SkyLark account
description: Turns on the Gate change alerts toggle in the SkyLark Profile settings so the user is notified when a gate changes.
patterns: Notify me when my gate changes

steps.intent: Tap Profile to open the profile settings.
Tap the Gate change alerts toggle to turn gate change alerts on.
